description: Extend a medium server by one to six months. Send the server id from the order and the number of months; each month is billed at the plan's monthly price. Pay in stablecoins with x402 or MPP. The server keeps its data and its IP. A server that is not renewed stops at its expiry date. Use the renew route that matches the server's plan.

id.description: the server id returned by the order

months.description: months to add; each month is billed at the plan's monthly price

name: vps-medium-renew
title: Renew a medium server
